Opportunity with Elite Fibre Optics!

Elite Fibre Optics is seeking experienced telecommunications workers to join our growing team!

Elite is a well-established and respected name in the telecommunications industry, with a strong pipeline of secured work across South East Queensland and regional locations throughout Australia. We offer opportunities to work across a diverse range of telecommunications projects, from commercial installations and high-rise fit-outs to structured data cabling and large-scale telecommunications infrastructure projects.

If you're an experienced telecommunications worker looking for competitive pay, quality equipment, career development and a supportive team environment, we'd love to hear from you!


What You'll Be Doing

Work will vary across a range of telecommunications projects and may include:

  • Building and installing fibre networks in apartment buildings, high-rise developments and multi-unit complexes.

  • Installing fibre optic and structured data cabling in commercial premises.

  • Running, routing and terminating fibre and data cables.

  • Terminating data outlets, patch panels and telecommunications racks.

  • Completing fibre splicing, testing and commissioning.

  • Installing NBN infrastructure, including PCDs, NTDs and associated cabling.

  • Working at heights using scissor lifts and other access equipment.

  • Working alongside civil teams on fibre network construction and infrastructure projects.

  • Travelling for away work and completing overtime when required, with applicable allowances and overtime paid.


What We Offer

  • Competitive pay rates commensurate with experience and capability.

  • Take-home vehicle and fuel card for eligible roles.

  • High-quality tools, equipment and machinery supplied.

  • Company uniforms supplied and replaced as required.

  • iPad or laptop supplied for eligible roles.

  • Travel or away-work allowances.

  • Ongoing training, upskilling and professional development.

  • Opportunities to progress within a growing telecommunications business.


Why Work for Elite Fibre Optics?

At Elite, we take pride in the quality of our work, our people and our company image. We have an experienced workforce, modern equipment and a team-focused culture that encourages employees to develop their skills and take pride in what they do.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of projects, gain experience in different areas of telecommunications and be part of a team that values safety, quality workmanship and reliability.

What sets us apart:

  • A supportive and energetic team environment.

  • A diverse workload across NBN, commercial, data and network carrier infrastructure projects.

  • Opportunities to develop your skills in construction, fibre splicing and network installations.

  • Modern equipment and professional workwear.

  • A focus on training, career progression and work-life balance.

  • Local work throughout South East Queensland, with opportunities for regional and interstate projects.


What We're Looking For

Successful applicants will ideally possess:

  • Previous experience in telecommunications, fibre optic installations or structured data cabling.

  • Experience with NBN MDU builds, commercial installations or high-rise projects is highly regarded.

  • A current Australian driver's licence.

  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn.

  • Reliability, punctuality and a professional presentation.

  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • The ability to undertake physical work, including working outdoors and at heights.

  • A commitment to safe work practices and quality workmanship.

  • The right to work in Australia.


Who We Are

Based in Stapylton, Queensland, Elite Fibre Optics operates in a prime location between Brisbane, Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast delivering telecommunications solutions across South East Queensland, regional Queensland and interstate.

We provide end-to-end telecommunications services, from site surveys and network design support through to the construction, installation, splicing, testing and commissioning of fibre optic networks.

Our projects include:

  • Fibre infrastructure and unit installations in apartment buildings, high-rise developments and multi-unit complexes.

  • Commercial NBN installations and structured data cabling.

  • New high-rise developments and existing building retrofits.

  • Telco infrastructure for schools, aged care facilities and shopping centres.

  • Fibre network construction for carriers.

  • Civil telecommunications infrastructure, including pit and pipe, underground conduit installation, horizontal directional drilling (HDD) and vacuum excavation.

Our experienced teams work together to deliver quality outcomes across the entire project lifecycle.


Ready to Join Elite?

If you're an experienced Telecommunications Worker looking for your next opportunity with a company that invests in equipment and encourages professional development, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the Elite Fibre Optics team!

Visit our website: www.elitefibreoptics.com.au

Be Bold. Belong. Be More.

At Southern Cross University, we do things differently, and so can you.

A career with us is more than you might expect. Yes, it’s about the heart, connectedness and community you’d hope for in a regional university. But there’s also so much more. Our game changing Southern Cross Model brings a deeper, focused learning experience and our research is deeply connected to our regions, making a difference on a global scale. This is your chance to help us build something new and meaningful for our students, our communities and your career. To drive change, make a real impact, and thrive in a place as unique as you.

You can be good anywhere. Here, you can be great.

Your opportunity

Technology plays a vital role in how we teach, learn and connect. At Southern Cross University, we're looking for a Senior Technical Support Analyst with strong audiovisual (AV) expertise to ensure our teaching spaces, meeting rooms and collaborative environments work seamlessly.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, supporting people and making technology work when it matters most. From troubleshooting AV systems in teaching rooms to supporting Microsoft Teams meetings, presentations and conferencing facilities, you'll help staff and students get the most from the technology around them.

You'll work across our university campuses, providing specialist technical support for AV equipment, meeting room systems and associated technologies. You'll also contribute to system improvements, preventative maintenance, technical documentation and the resolution of complex issues, working with colleagues and vendors to deliver reliable, high-quality support.

If you're technically curious, customer-focused and enjoy being the person who can resolve a challenging problem, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a dynamic university environment.

You will make an impact by:

  • Providing hands on AV support across teaching rooms, meeting spaces and presentation environments
  • Troubleshooting audiovisual, conferencing and Microsoft Teams meeting technologies
  • Maintaining and improving AV systems through testing, updates and preventative checks
  • Supporting staff and students with technical guidance, training and problem resolution
  • Leading complex technical escalations and working with vendors to improve system reliability

What you will bring

You'll be an experienced technical support professional with a strong understanding of audiovisual technology and a practical, solutions-focused approach. You enjoy working directly with people, diagnosing problems under pressure and ensuring technology works reliably for teaching, meetings and events.

You will be confident supporting AV and conferencing environments, including room-based presentation systems, Microsoft Teams meetings and integrated audio and video technologies. Experience with systems such as Q-SYS, Crestron or similar AV control platforms will be highly regarded.

You bring the judgement to manage complex technical issues independently, communicate clearly with users and collaborate with other technical teams when problems require a broader solution. You'll also enjoy sharing your knowledge, helping colleagues develop their skills and identifying ways to prevent recurring issues.

To succeed in this role, you will also need:

  • Relevant IT, AV or electronics qualification, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated experience in AV support, troubleshooting and user assistance
  • Strong knowledge of conferencing platforms, AV equipment and system integration
  • Excellent problem solving, communication and customer service skills
  • A current driver’s license, willing to travel between campuses and a valid Working With Children Check 

Why Southern Cross University

SCU is proudly a regional university, young, small and vibrant. That means you’ll find more exposure, opportunity and ownership - to grow, achieve and build a career that means more. And you’ll do it alongside passionate people and leaders who go the extra mile to help you succeed. A career with us is about more than just work. It’s about place, community and the life you want to live. With three main campuses at the Gold Coast, Coffs Harbour and the Northern Rivers region of NSW, we’re integral to all these wonderful communities. Find your place and be more in this beautiful part of the world.

Your opportunity is:

  • Full-time, continuing (permanent)
  • Located at Coffs Harbour, NSW 2450. Relocation assistance is available, making it easier to join our regional communities
  • HEW Level 7. The base salary ranges from $111,612 - $121,190 per annum, plus 17% employer’s contribution to superannuation. The total remuneration package is up to $141,792.

You will enjoy a range of perks designed to support your wellbeing, growth and work-life balance. For more information on our benefits and what it’s like to work at SCU, visit Why work at Southern Cross University?

Be more with Southern Cross University today

About us

VenueSumo is the all-in-one POS, online ticketing and venue management platform for family entertainment centres, amusement parks and attractions. Venue operators run their whole business on us: bookings and ticketing, point of sale, waivers, memberships, CRM, payments, gift cards and more. We're an Australian-born SaaS scale-up growing fast across Australia, North America and the UK. We've just closed a growth equity round, and we're investing it in the team and the product. Our ambition is big: to make VenueSumo the leading AI-native operating system for leisure and attractions, where intelligent automation handles the busywork and operators spend their time on guests.

About the role

You'll be one of the most senior hands-on engineers at VenueSumo. You'll build features end to end across our .NET backend, SQL Server data layer and web front end, and you'll own the Microsoft Azure infrastructure they run on. As a technical lead, you'll set the bar for code quality, lead the technical design of major features and integrations, and mentor the engineers around you. You'll work closely with our Head of Engineering and CTO on architecture and on modernising the platform. You'll also make our cloud platform resilient, secure, observable and cost-efficient as we scale across three continents. Above all, we're looking for a systems thinker and an innovative problem solver. You'll use the best AI development tools every day, but AI is there to amplify great engineers, not to do the thinking for them. We want someone who understands problems deeply, sees how the pieces of a complex platform fit together, and designs solutions that last.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build and ship features end to end: C#/.NET services and APIs, SQL Server, and modern web front ends

  • Own your work from first prototype to production, including testing, release and support

  • Work with Product to turn ideas into working prototypes in days, then harden them into production features

  • Take on the hardest technical problems: performance, data integrity, reporting and complex business logic

  • Fix customer-raised issues quickly and at the root cause, not just the symptom

  • Own the Azure environment our platform runs on: compute, databases, storage, networking, CDN and identity

  • Define infrastructure as code so every environment is repeatable and version controlled

  • Build and run CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) that let us ship small changes safely and often

  • Make the platform observable, with monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response using Azure Monitor and Application Insights

  • Lead on reliability, scalability, backup and disaster recovery, and on multi-region readiness as we grow across Australia, North America and the UK

About you

  • A systems architect's mindset. You think about how a whole platform fits together (data, services, integrations and infrastructure) and design for scale, resilience and change

  • A track record as an innovative problem solver: you break down complex, ambiguous problems, weigh the trade-offs and find elegant solutions

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including time as a lead or senior engineer setting technical direction for a team

  • Strong full stack skills: C#/.NET and SQL Server (T-SQL), plus modern web front ends (JavaScript/TypeScript; React or similar)

  • Proven hands-on experience designing, building and running production infrastructure on Microsoft Azure

  • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions)

  • Solid knowledge of Azure networking, identity and security (virtual networks, Microsoft Entra ID, Key Vault, managed identities), and monitoring with Azure Monitor and Application Insights

  • Experience with performance tuning, scaling, high availability and disaster recovery for a production SaaS platform

  • Experience designing APIs and integrations at scale, and modernising a mature codebase while it keeps serving customers

  • Deep, current hands-on use of AI coding tools, paired with the judgement to know where AI helps and where careful thinking matters more

Benefits

  • A senior, hands-on lead role in a freshly funded, fast-growing SaaS business

  • Real influence over our architecture, our infrastructure and how we build the leading AI-native operating system for leisure and attractions

  • A generous budget for the best AI tools. No waiting for approval to try what's new

  • Competitive salary

  • A Gold Coast office at Mermaid Beach, or remote from anywhere in Australia or New Zealand

  • A small team of highly talented senior developers who ship fast and work close to the venues that use our software every day

About Nexigen Digital

Every day our all-Australian team delivers exceptional service and outstanding support to our 200,000+ customers who choose us for their domain names, website hosting and digital marketing.


Over the past fifteen years, we have been constant game-changers, industry innovators, award winners, and community leaders - and now is your chance to join our team.




The Position


As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer at Nexigen Digital, you will work with a close, agile team to deliver new projects and continuous improvements to our internal and customer facing systems. We're looking for someone who is passionate about software quality, proactive, goal oriented and posses excellent problem solving skills.

We pride ourselves on maintaining a team culture that provides provides opportunities through collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous learning and development, and as such are able to provide opportunities to a range of developers with different skillsets and experience.

  • Throughly testing changes and new features added across our platforms
  • Creating detailed test plans and documentation to track outcomes
  • Liaise with developers and other stakeholders to have defects and quality issues corrected
  • Ensure that the final work product meets all the requirements of the feature's scope
  • Validate and verify that features and functions are working as intended
  • Educating software engineers on common defects and mentoring them in improving their own self-testing abilities

The right person (is it you?)

  • Has one to three years' experience working within the software development life cycle (we'll take personal & self taught experience into consideration as well)
  • Is extremely detail oriented and can identify user experience problems
  • Has a good understanding of software development and programming
  • Is curiosity and can 'think outside the box' to determine niche edge cases
  • Can problem solve and assist in debugging complex issues
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Knows their way around a command line and has an understanding of Linux environments
  • Has an excellent understanding of relational databases (particularly MySQL), is confident writing SQL queries
  • Can create specific test scenarios through manual manipulation (such as editing DB values, making minor code edits, 'faking' dates, etc)
  • Has worked with RESTful APIs and SOAP Web Services

Handy things to have (or are able to learn)

  • Experience with QA Software such as SoapUI, Postman, BurpSuite, ZAP, Fiddler
  • Experience with project management tools such as Jira and Trello
  • Experience with PHP and React.JS development
  • Knowledge of the Domain Names and Web Hosting (cPanel, WHM, Plesk, etc) industry
  • Knowing your way around Git (including GitHub) and has a good understanding of version control




The Benefits of Working With the Nexigen Digital Team


Aside from being awarded “Employer of Choice” in the Australian Business Awards, we are often referred to as the Google of south-east Melbourne thanks to our unique facilities and team culture, and a top-down mandate to take care of the people who take care of our customers.

We actively encourage training and upskilling for personal development and will fund courses that have a beneficial impact on the business.

jobs.job_description:
Ozdoc Solutions Partnership are Australia’s premier Medical IT provider. We custom design IT solutions to meet the needs of today’s demanding Health industry via the best combination of on premise, hybrid and complete cloud-systems including hardware, software, and state of the art digital solutions. We are committed to excellence, growth, integrity, and innovation while striving to be as human as possible, after all they are our core values.


“We care for technology so you can care for people”


About the Role

We are on the hunt for the next great team member.  


We’re looking for a super driven person to join our team as a Level 1/Entry level Associate Support Engineer. You'll learn to be hands-on with all our client support, receiving exposer to everything as you will become part of our First Response team delivering initial triage to servers, desktops, networks, you name it as you grow.


Still studying and have extra capacity, we will even consider someone working towards Graduation and looking for a foot in the door [Cert 3/4, Diploma or Degree] with strong customer service experience (ie retail, hospitality etc) and is the "go to" person for friends and family with their IT issues.


You'll need a growth mentality and a great can-do attitude, love working directly with people and most importantly be part of a strong team culture…..along with diligence, enthusiasm, willingness to go the extra mile, and desire to contribute and succeed.


Show your skill and there is plenty of opportunity to move quickly and grow within our team!


What Qualities are we looking for?  

  • Exceptional skills in dealing with people

  • A positive and friendly attitude

  • Passionate about solving client issues

  • A creative approach in solving problems

  • Most of all, a team player and willingness to grow.


What’s on Offer

  • A commencing salary of $55K plus superannuation will be offered with the potential for an increase following probation for an exceptional candidate.

  • Additional after hours renumeration on top of base salary

  • A proactive and supportive work environment, with up-to-date equipment, that supports employee development.

  • A challenging role where you are always learning!

  • Burleigh Heads based – work close to home

  • Flexible work options

  • Salary sacrifice plans

  • Employee referral program

  • Peer bonus program

  • Gift vouchers on your birthday and the day off, yes that’s right we don’t work birthdays at Ozdoc

  • Quarterly team building events

  • Monthly team lunches

  • Ability to be heard outside of the crowd


What stands out as a bonus to being shortlisted in this application?  

  • Already completed a graduate certification

  • Any Microsoft fundamental certifications

  • Any additional IT certifications

  • Any certification that isn’t IT related however can be applied to this role


Want to join the Ozdoc team?

If you are ready to build your CAREER with an organisation that prides itself on intimacy with its customers and building a strong team, then send your application in now!


Applicants are asked to provide a current resume along with details/ evidence to support the above requirements of the role.

 

Please note that only applicants meeting the criteria outlined above will be contacted as part of the short-listing process.

About Ozdoc Solutions

Ozdoc Solutions Partnership is Australia’s premier Medical IT provider, delivering customised technology solutions to meet the needs of today's demanding healthcare industry.


We design and implement the best combination of on-premise, hybrid and complete cloud systems, incorporating hardware, software and state-of-the-art digital solutions.


We are committed to excellence, growth, integrity and innovation, while always striving to be as human as possible — after all, our clients and our team are at the heart of everything we do.


“We care for technology so you can care for people.”

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Level 2 Support Engineer to join our team and take the next step in their IT career.


This is a hands-on technical support role where you'll be working directly with our healthcare clients to investigate, troubleshoot and resolve more complex IT issues across their environments.


You'll be part of a professional support team, taking escalated issues beyond first-response troubleshooting and working through problems across servers, desktops, networks, Microsoft environments, cloud systems and other technologies within our clients' environments.


We're not simply looking for someone who wants to stay at Level 2. We're looking for someone with the drive and capability to keep developing.


For the right person, there are two potential career pathways:

Pathway 1 – L2 Support → L3 Support

Continue developing your technical depth, taking on increasingly complex escalations, troubleshooting and infrastructure responsibilities as you progress towards a Level 3 Support Engineer role.

Pathway 2 – L2 Support → L2 Field Engineer → L3 Field Engineer

For someone who enjoys getting out from behind the desk, there is also the opportunity to develop into a Field Engineering role, gaining greater hands-on exposure to client environments, projects and infrastructure before progressing towards L3 Field Engineering.

The pathway will depend on your strengths, interests and career aspirations.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Provide Level 2 technical support to clients across a range of IT environments

  • Investigate and resolve escalated technical issues

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, network and connectivity issues

  • Support Microsoft and cloud-based environments

  • Diagnose issues across desktops, servers and network infrastructure

  • Manage tickets through to resolution while maintaining clear client communication

  • Escalate complex issues appropriately and work collaboratively with other engineers

  • Assist with maintaining and supporting client infrastructure

  • Contribute to projects, improvements and technology upgrades

  • Document solutions, processes and technical information

  • Build strong relationships with clients through exceptional communication and service

  • Continue developing your technical knowledge and capabilities

 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who already has a solid foundation in IT support and is ready to take their technical career further.


You'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience working in a Level 2 IT Support role or at least 18 months working in a Level 1 IT Support role.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities

  • Experience supporting Windows desktop environments

  • Exposure to Microsoft 365 and cloud technologies

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals

  • Experience working with servers and/or infrastructure

  • The ability to diagnose problems rather than simply follow a script

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills

  • A positive, proactive and can-do attitude

  • The ability to work independently while being a strong team player

  • A genuine desire to learn, develop and progress your career


Relevant IT qualifications and certifications will be highly regarded, including Microsoft certifications and other industry-recognised technical qualifications.


We're also interested in where you want to go next. If you're ambitious, enjoy solving problems and want to develop towards L3 Support or Field Engineering, we'd like to hear from you.


What’s on Offer

  • $75,000 – $85,000 + superannuation, depending on experience and capability

  • Genuine career development opportunities

  • Clear pathways towards L3 Support or L2/L3 Field Engineering

  • Additional after-hours remuneration on top of your base salary

  • Proactive and supportive work environment

  • Up-to-date technology and equipment

  • Challenging work where you're always learning

  • Burleigh Heads location — work close to home

  • Flexible work options

  • Salary sacrifice plans

  • Employee referral program

  • Peer bonus program

  • Birthday gift voucher and the day off — yes, we don't work birthdays at Ozdoc !

  • Quarterly team-building events

  • Monthly team lunches

  • The opportunity to have your ideas heard and make a genuine contribution

 

Why Ozdoc?

At Ozdoc, you're not just another technician working through a queue of tickets.


You'll become part of a close-knit team supporting clients where technology genuinely matters. You'll have exposure to a broad range of environments, the opportunity to work on interesting technical challenges and the support to keep developing your career.


If you're ready to move beyond Level 2 and want a role where your next step is part of the plan, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.


Want to Join the Ozdoc Team?

If you're an experienced Level 2 Support Engineer ready to build your technical career with an organisation that values its people, its clients and continuous development, we'd love to hear from you.


Please submit your current resume along with details and evidence of your experience, qualifications and technical capabilities.


Only applicants meeting the criteria outlined above will be contacted as part of the shortlisting process.

The Company

LAPM specialises in providing top-tier legal practice management, technology and services to law firms across Australia.

Based on the Gold Coast and growing rapidly, we've built a strong reputation for solving real challenges faced by law firms — from software migrations and implementations to developing innovative legal technology products that make running a law firm easier.

We are preparing for the official launch of our new legal cloud platform. Designed specifically for Australian law firms, our product brings together matter management, documents, workflows, billing, trust accounting and more into one integrated platform.

We're looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Junior–Mid Full-Stack Developer to join our growing technology team at an exciting stage of our journey.

You'll help us build new features, improve existing functionality, resolve technical challenges and contribute to the ongoing development of a platform designed to make a genuine difference to how law firms operate.

The Role

As a Junior–Mid Full-Stack Developer, you'll work across our application stack, contributing to both frontend and backend development.

You'll be involved in building intuitive user interfaces, developing backend functionality, working with databases and supporting application testing and deployment. Working closely with our Lead Developer, you'll receive guidance, feedback and opportunities to develop your technical skills while taking ownership of your work.

We're a growing business with a practical, collaborative approach to development. You'll have the opportunity to see your work make a real impact, contribute ideas and help shape a product as it evolves.

The role offers flexible remote working, alongside regular collaboration days at our Gold Coast office.

What You’ll Do

  • Feature Development: Write clean, maintainable code to implement new features across the front-end and back-end.

  • Bug Fixing & Maintenance: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve performance bottlenecks, UI glitches, and functional bugs, tracing issues to their root cause.

  • Database Work: Write and optimise SQL queries and help ensure the accuracy of billing and accounting data.

  • Testing: Write and maintain automated tests to keep our platform stable.

  • Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, daily stand-ups, and brainstorming sessions to improve platform functionality.

  • Documentation: Keep codebase documentation up to date to ensure seamless scaling as the team grows.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development, strong problem-solving skills and a genuine interest in building great software.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience developing web applications, whether commercially or through a strong portfolio of practical projects.

  • Technical Skills: Experience with Python and/or TypeScript, with a willingness to work across both. Our technology stack includes Python (FastAPI), React / Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

  • Database Knowledge: Sound SQL skills, including the ability to understand, write and troubleshoot queries.

  • Cloud Awareness: Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate issues, understand existing code and develop practical solutions.

  • Code Quality: An understanding of clean coding principles, version control and good software development practices.

  • Security Awareness: An appreciation of data privacy, application security and the importance of protecting sensitive client information.

  • Communication & Collaboration: The ability to communicate effectively, ask questions, receive feedback and work as part of a collaborative team.

  • Working Rights: Full working rights in Australia.

You don't need to know everything from day one. We're equally interested in your ability to learn, your approach to solving problems and your willingness to develop your skills.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience or exposure to any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Automated testing frameworks and testing practices.

  • CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes and AWS infrastructure.

  • Accounting, billing, financial or other data-intensive software applications.

  • AI APIs, integrations or AI-assisted development tools.

  • Legal technology, fintech, cybersecurity or other industries where data accuracy and security are critical.

The Person

Beyond your technical skills, we're looking for someone who enjoys building software, solving problems and being part of a team that takes pride in what it delivers.

You'll be someone who:

  • Enjoys solving problems — you're naturally curious, like understanding how things work and aren't afraid to investigate a challenge.

  • Takes pride in your work — you care about writing quality code, getting the details right and delivering functionality that works as intended.

  • Is keen to learn and grow — you're open to feedback, willing to ask questions and motivated to continually improve your technical skills.

  • Shows initiative — you're comfortable working through problems independently while knowing when to seek guidance or collaborate with others.

  • Thinks beyond the code — you understand that great software isn't just about technical functionality; it's about creating a better experience for the people using it.

  • Works well with others — you're approachable, communicate clearly and enjoy contributing to a collaborative development environment.

  • Embraces change — you're adaptable, open to new ideas and comfortable working in a growing business where priorities and opportunities evolve.

  • Wants to make an impact — you're excited by the opportunity to contribute to a product, see your work come to life and help shape its future.

Most importantly, you'll care about what you're building and the people using it.

We're not developing software for the sake of it. We're building technology that solves real problems for Australian law firms, and we want someone who shares that focus.

Why LAPM?

Be part of something growing.

You'll be joining an Australian technology company at an exciting stage, with the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development and launch of our flagship software platform.

Work on a real product with real impact.

Your work won't disappear into a backlog of projects. You'll help build and improve software that law firms rely on to manage their day-to-day operations.

Learn from experienced developers.

You'll work closely with our Lead Developer, gaining practical experience, technical guidance and opportunities to develop your skills across a modern application stack.

Have a voice in what we build.

We're a collaborative team that values ideas, initiative and continuous improvement. You'll have opportunities to contribute to technical discussions, product enhancements and how we approach development.

Enjoy flexibility and a supportive team.

We offer flexible working arrangements, with regular opportunities to collaborate in person at our Gold Coast office.

Grow with the business.

As LAPM continues to expand, you'll have opportunities to broaden your experience, take on greater responsibility and grow your career alongside our technology team.

We're a practical, down-to-earth team. We work hard, support each other and take pride in delivering solutions that make a difference.

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your skills, contribute to an exciting software product and be part of a growing Australian technology business, we'd love to hear from you.

The Next Step

If you're interested in this role and meet the criteria mentioned above, please click 'apply now.' We look forward to receiving your application and discussing how you can contribute to our team.

You know how to sell complex services into SMB and mid-market organisations.

Not products. Not licences. Not simple transactional deals. Services.

First Focus is looking for a proven Solution Consultant who can turn qualified conversations into high-quality commercial outcomes. We are the leading managed AI and IT services provider in Australia and New Zealand, and our marketing engine creates a strong flow of opportunities with businesses already exploring change.

Your role is to qualify well, run sharp discovery, shape the right solution and close clients who are a strong fit for our managed AI, managed IT, cloud, cyber, modern workplace and project capabilities.

This is a individual contributor role. It is not a training-ground sales position, and it is not a lead generation role. You will need to arrive with developed discovery skills, commercial discipline and the ability to build trust with executives quickly.

What You Will Be Doing

You will work with businesses typically in the 20 to 200 seat range that are reviewing their IT environment, AI initiatives, security posture, systems maturity or current technology partner.

AI is at the forefront of this role. First Focus is the market leader in helping SMBs do more with AI in practical, secure and commercially useful ways. You will be at the heart of those conversations, helping business leaders move from curiosity and experimentation to clear priorities, sensible adoption and measurable outcomes.

You will lead the commercial conversation from qualification through to proposal and close. That means understanding the client’s business, identifying real pain, testing urgency, mapping decision process and shaping a solution that is commercially sound and operationally deliverable.

You will work closely with technical specialists, but you will own the sales process. You do not need to be the deepest technical person in the room. You do need to know how to translate AI, security, cloud and managed services capability into business value, ask strong questions and keep the conversation moving toward a decision.

You will write clear, credible proposals that help senior stakeholders understand the case for change. You will also ensure clean handovers into onboarding and delivery, because selling something properly includes setting the client and the delivery team up for success.

About You

You have already sold complex B2B services and you understand that services sales is different from product sales. Trust matters earlier. Discovery matters more. The value has to be made clear before the client can confidently move.

You are curious about AI and already using it to work smarter. You experiment with it in your professional and personal life, not because it is trendy, but because you can see how it improves research, communication, productivity, decision-making and client outcomes.

You are likely to be a strong fit if you have:

  • At least five years of consultative selling, solution consulting or services sales experience.

  • A track record selling managed services, professional services, IT consulting, cyber, cloud, systems integration, AI-enabled services or similar complex services.

  • Experience selling into SMB or mid-market organisations.

  • Confidence speaking with owners, CEOs, CFOs, COOs, IT leaders and senior managers.

  • The ability to qualify firmly and avoid wasting time on weak opportunities.

  • Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear proposals.

  • Enough technical curiosity to learn our service lines quickly and know when to bring in specialists.

  • A genuine interest in AI and how it can help businesses improve performance.

  • Commercial maturity, high standards and the expectation that your remuneration should reflect the value you create.

This role is probably not right if your experience is mainly lead generation, account management, product sales or enterprise sales with large internal bid teams around you. It is also not right if you need a highly scripted sales process to be effective, or if AI is something you only talk about rather than actively use.

What Great Looks Like

Within six months, you will be running strong executive discovery with limited supervision, converting a meaningful percentage of assigned opportunities, producing commercially sharp proposals and contributing materially to new recurring revenue.

You will be trusted by prospects because you understand their business. You will be trusted internally because you qualify properly, sell accurately and set expectations clearly.

You will also be helping SMB leaders understand where AI can create real business value, where they need better foundations first and how First Focus can help them move forward safely and practically.

Why First Focus

First Focus is the leading managed AI and IT services provider in Australia and New Zealand, with more than 400 specialists across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines.

We are at the front of helping SMBs use AI to work smarter, improve productivity, strengthen decision-making and modernise the way they operate. You will have genuine delivery depth behind you, strong brand credibility and a proven marketing engine creating qualified demand.

You will not be building a pipeline from scratch. You will be working with businesses that already know who we are and are actively exploring options. Your job is to turn the right opportunities into long-term client relationships.

Benefits

  • Strong base-weighted remuneration with achievable performance incentives.

  • Hybrid work and flexible hours.

  • Paid study days and structured professional development.

  • Generous parental leave and wellbeing programs.

  • Extra leave for volunteering or community work.

  • Referral bonuses and profit share, subject to eligibility.

  • Access to deep technical capability across managed AI, managed IT, cloud, cyber, modern workplace and projects.

If you already know how to sell professional services, are genuinely curious about AI and want a senior IC role with qualified demand, strong delivery capability and serious earning potential, we would be happy to speak with you.

Questions before applying? Reach out to Brendan Ritchie for a confidential conversation.

First Focus welcomes applications from Neurodiverse candidates. We recommend & appreciate disclosure along with the application so that a copy of our Neurodiversity Statement can be provided outlining the flexible options we can offer to best showcase your skills.

About the role

You're the first voice customers hear when something goes wrong. You'll resolve routine issues quickly, keep customers informed, and hand complex problems to our Level 2 team with clear notes so nobody has to ask the same question twice.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide frontline support by phone, email, and chat within agreed SLAs

  • Log, triage, and document every request accurately in a ticketing system

  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and account issues

  • Build, configure, and maintain our Standard Operating Environment (SOE), the standardised desktop setup we deploy to customers

  • Test new product releases and help with QA

  • Escalate complex or high-risk issues with clear context and next steps

  • Keep support documentation current and suggest ways to improve our processes

About you

  • Some hands-on IT support experience, whether from a help desk, a placement, or your own projects. Entry-level candidates who show strong aptitude are welcome.

  • Practical troubleshooting skills across Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, and networking basics

  • Clear, jargon-free communication, written and spoken. You stay calm and courteous when a customer is frustrated.

  • The ability to juggle multiple tickets and prioritise based on urgency and impact

  • Care with detail, especially when handling customer data and access

  • IT qualification or certification (e.g. CompTIA A+, Microsoft MD-102/MS-900, Certificate III or IV in IT), or experience with ticketing system (nice to have)

  • Employment is subject to a Police Check

About us

For over 20 years, Cortech has provided products and services to customers. Our customers stay with us because our support team treats every call like it matters, and we give them the tools and training to do it well.

Please send your CV to info@cortechsystems.com.au

About Nexigen Digital

Every day our all-Australian team delivers exceptional service and outstanding support to our 200,000+ customers who choose us for their domain names, website hosting and online presence.


Over the past seventeen years, we have been constant game-changers, industry innovators, award winners, and community leaders - and now is your chance to join our team.



Role Purpose


At Nexigen Digital, we generate valuable data across multiple platforms and aim to consolidate these data points into a single source of truth. We are looking for a hands-on Business Intelligence Developer to build our data architecture from the ground up.


In this 12-month contract, you will own the end-to-end data lifecycle, from extracting raw data from our disconnected systems and building a centralised data warehouse. Designing interactive dashboards that will drive our executive decision-making. If you succeed in laying this foundation, there is a strong intent to transition this role into a permanent, ongoing position leading our analytics strategy.



Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL processes, data integration solutions and automated data pipelines across multiple source systems.
  • Architect and build a centralised data warehouse or data mart, ensuring the data is cleaned, modelled accurately and optimised for reporting.
  • Develop, deploy, and maintain interactive, automated dashboards that track key business metrics and trends.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to translate vague business questions into concrete data requirements and actionable insights.


Skills & Experience


Essential

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and consulting skills.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, merging, and transforming complex datasets.
  • Expertise in building commercial dashboards in a Business Intelligence environment
  • Excellent communication skills – listening, written and verbal


Desirable

About Custodian 

Custodian is an Australian property investment company with a long history of helping Australians build long-term wealth through residential property investment. 

Our end-to-end investment model brings together property strategy, finance, property acquisition, construction and property management support, providing clients with a simpler, lower-risk way to invest in new property. 

Technology is increasingly central to how we attract and manage clients, operate our business, manage data and deliver an exceptional client experience. 

We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Salesforce & Technology Lead to take ownership of Salesforce and help shape the technology, systems and processes that will support Custodian's next phase of growth. 

The Opportunity 

This is an in-office role based at our Gold Coast office.

This is a newly created role for someone who can operate at the intersection of Salesforce, technology, data and business improvement. 

You will be Custodian's internal Salesforce expert and technology lead, working closely with senior leaders and teams across the business to identify opportunities, solve problems and implement practical technology solutions. 

The role combines hands-on Salesforce development and optimisation with technology strategy, project leadership, automation, data, integrations and vendor management. 

We are looking for someone who is strategic enough to see the bigger picture, but hands-on enough to roll up their sleeves and make things happen. You will also be responsible for managing external consultants for specialist assistance as needed, and ensuring technology optimisation projects are delivered in a timely and efficient manner, and on budget. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own the ongoing development, optimisation and performance of Salesforce as a critical business platform. 

  • Act as Custodian's primary Salesforce subject matter expert and provide technical guidance across the business. 

  • Design, configure, develop and implement Salesforce solutions, including Flows, automation, reports, dashboards and, where appropriate, Apex and Lightning Web Components. 

  • Translate business requirements and pain points into practical, scalable technology solutions. 

  • Improve data quality, governance, reporting and visibility across the customer lifecycle. 

  • Design, manage and improve integrations, APIs and data flows between Salesforce and other business systems. 

  • Lead technology and systems projects from concept through to implementation, including requirements, planning, testing, delivery and adoption. 

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve productivity through technology, AI and workflow automation. 

  • Manage external Salesforce developers, consultants and technology providers, ensuring appropriate scope, quality, cost and delivery. 

  • Evaluate technology solutions and suppliers based on business value, risk, cost and return on investment. 

  • Ensure technology systems are appropriately secure, reliable, documented and governed. 

  • Support Salesforce adoption through effective user engagement, training and continuous improvement. 

  • Stay informed about emerging Salesforce, AI and technology capabilities and identify those with genuine commercial application for Custodian. 

Skills & Experience 

Essential 

  • Significant experience in a senior Salesforce, business systems, technology or digital transformation role. 

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience across configuration, automation, development, reporting and data management. 

  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and ideally Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and Salesforce APIs. 

  • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or Salesforce projects from requirements through to implementation. 

  • Experience managing external technology consultants, developers or suppliers. 

  • Strong business process improvement and problem-solving skills. 

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 

  • Commercial mindset with an ability to assess technology based on business value, cost, risk and ROI. 

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership and drive initiatives through to completion. 

Desirable 

  • Salesforce certifications. 

  • Understanding of cybersecurity, privacy and technology governance. 

  • Experience in property, financial services, professional services or another customer-facing environment. 

The Person 

You are: 

  • Strategic but hands-on – able to develop a roadmap but equally comfortable getting into Salesforce and building the solution. 

  • Commercial – focused on business outcomes, not technology for technology's sake. 

  • A problem solver – naturally curious and motivated to find better ways of doing things. 

  • Pragmatic – able to balance the ideal solution with what is practical and valuable. 

  • Influential – confident working with senior leaders, frontline teams and technical specialists. 

  • Accountable – you take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. 

  • A strong communicator – able to explain complex technology in straightforward business language. 

Why Join Custodian? 

This is an opportunity to build, not simply maintain. 

You will have genuine ownership of Custodian's Salesforce and technology capability and the opportunity to influence how the business operates as it enters its next phase of growth. 

You'll work directly with senior leaders and teams across the business, with the autonomy to bring in specialist expertise where required. 

Most importantly, you'll see your work translate directly into better systems, less administration, better data, greater productivity and a better experience for our clients and our people. 

We also invest heavily in our culture so you’ll work alongside people who genuinely enjoying coming to work each day, enjoy social functions, weekly yoga class and paid birthday leave. 

If this role sounds like a good fit? Or perhaps you feel you can undertake most, but not all of the role, please reach out. We’d still like to speak with you.
